summary: RptMnuEmploymentChanges is an ASP.NET user control for generating reports about employment changes (newly employed, resigned, or both) within a specified date range. It provides options for Placement Coordinators and other users to export data in Excel format and supports field validation, filtering, and conditional report generation.
purpose: To enable users (especially Placement Coordinators) to generate reports showing employment changes between two dates, filtered by employment status, and export the results to Excel. The control validates date inputs and offers options for how the report is generated and displayed.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.purpose: Specifies the start date for the report's filter.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.purpose: Specifies the end date for the report's filter.

fields.name: radNewlyEmployed
fields.purpose: Filter report for newly employed individuals.

fields.name: radNewlyResigned
fields.purpose: Filter report for newly resigned individuals.

fields.name: radBoth
fields.purpose: Filter report for both employment and resignation.

fields.name: cmdRunExcel
fields.purpose: Triggers report generation and Excel export.

fields.name: ValidationSummary1
fields.purpose: Displays validation messages for the form.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.role: User interacting with the report menu; can be a Placement Coordinator or other user.

actors.name: Placement Coordinator
actors.role: Special actor; triggers different stored procedure and report logic.

workflows.name: Generate Employment Changes Report
steps: User selects date range and employment change type (employed, resigned, or both).
Input fields validated (required, format, custom logic).
If user is Placement Coordinator, set procedure to 'ReportEmploymentChangesPA'. Otherwise, use 'ReportEmploymentChanges'.
Add parameters to database call: SessionID, DateFrom, DateTo, employment statuses.
Display report HTML if results found; make panel visible.

business_rules: Different stored procedures and report logic depending on user role (Placement Coordinator vs others).
Date range and employment status filter affect report content.
validations: Start and end date fields are required.
Start and end date must match a valid format (Regex validation).
Custom validation may be applied (details not specified).
conditions: If radNewlyEmployed checked, report only newly employed (EmployStatus1 = 'EmployedStart', EmployStatus2 = '').
If radNewlyResigned checked, report only resigned (EmployStatus1 = '', EmployStatus2 = 'Resigned').
If neither, report both statuses (EmployStatus1 = 'EmployedStart', EmployStatus2 = 'Resigned').
system_behavior: Loads report options and description on pre-render.
Registers JavaScript variables for client controls.
Displays report results only if report data is found.
exceptions: If no report data is found, report panel not shown.
Incorrect date input triggers validation errors.
content_gaps: No information about report filtering beyond the fields described.
No error handling beyond UI field validation.
